screens.name: Home — empty omen and populated omen
screens.evidence: Sheets 09–10 show a dominant orb and consistent navigation, with supplied browser evidence reporting enlargement and motion checks; A=8.7, F=8.3, overall=8.5.

screens.name: Approach

screens.name: Ask — myself, normal and large text

screens.name: Ask — named person, normal and 200%

findings: Stack the subject choices at 200% so each checkmark remains aligned with its label and the question retains more viewport space.

screens.name: Follow-up card 1
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 presents a readable prompt and spacious rows with stable transition geometry, supported by reported keyboard advancement and focus transfer; A=9.0, F=8.7, overall=8.8.

screens.name: Follow-up card 2

screens.name: Follow-up card 3 — synthetic sequence

screens.name: Custom follow-up answer — normal and large text

screens.name: Onboarding — age confirmation, normal and 200%

screens.name: Onboarding — birthday, normal and 200%

screens.name: Onboarding — focus unselected, normal and 200%

screens.name: Onboarding — focus selected, normal and 200%

screens.name: Voice unavailable

limitations: All scores are provisional browser assessments based on the attached screenshots and supplied runtime account; no files, source, previous grades or live browser states were inspected.
A is the normalized mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the normalized mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall uses unrounded means with 40% A and 60% F.
Reported runtime checks support interaction scores but were not independently rerun; screenshot appearance alone does not prove functionality.
Transition pairs show broadly stable geometry and visual roles, but still images cannot independently establish continuous animation quality or absence of intermediate layout shifts.

Content below a screenshot edge is not treated as unreachable because scrollable forms and layout checks are explicitly reported; the enlarged input's visible clipping remains a reviewability concern.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, hardware keyboard, microphone, haptics, real payments, configured social services and OS delivery remain unverified.
Screenshots do not show every validation, preparing, export-failure, focus or live-announcement state; automated axe results do not establish all assistive-technology behavior.
Synthetic prediction and evidence wording is treated as layout stress content, not a production-copy defect or evidence of predictive quality.
No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied material; this does not establish untested boundaries as passing.
The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across all screens and components; individual provisional browser scores of 9 do not certify native quality.
topFixes: Improve 200% entry layouts: keep subject checkmarks with their labels and provide a clearer, larger question-editing window.
Make immediate answer advancement explicit, especially when the last answer starts the forecast.
Improve long evidence navigation through clearer context, assumption and source grouping without shortening the stress fixtures.
Add persistent birthday-editor labeling and explain disabled birth-detail and offline circle actions at their point of use.
Reduce duplicate outcome notices and keep recovery explanations close to their actions.
Capture and verify browser focus, announcement, validation and export-status states before raising their provisional scores.
